title: Arrays and objects
goal: Model a list of products and transform it without unwanted mutation.
explanation: An array represents an ordered collection. An object groups named properties. A products array can contain objects with id, name and price fields.
map creates an array of transformed values; filter creates an array of items that pass a condition; find returns the first matching item or undefined.
Use stable identifiers for records. Consider whether a method changes its input: sort mutates an array, while mapping or filtering creates a new array.
exercise: Create three products, filter those below R50, and produce their names.
hint: Filter first, then map the remaining objects to their names.

quiz.question: Which method keeps only matching items?
quiz.explanation: filter returns a new array containing every item that passes the predicate.
